subject: trackp start: each person runs their own personal track
body: New command: python3 -m autoresearch.taste.trackp start [--name ...]. It asks for the name, creates data/researchers/<slug>/, takes consent at the terminal and runs the seed items (resumable). Each team member gets their own dataset. Note: init/start still point tracks.json key P at the most recent person, so R1-P uses whoever ran last. Choosing which person each run uses is not decided yet. The unfinished ethan_cai dataset was removed. Commit d9c3222.
